limits: Physical fast user switching, sleep and login-screen behavior were not newly qualified; two-account access uses real XPC and the exact signed GUI diagnostic in a VM.

No new MagicDNS/IPv6 packet-capture qualification; the existing profile and cleanup rules are unchanged and their contracts pass.
Rendered dashboard fixtures use synthetic data; they are not screenshots of a physical Mac.
Release binaries are ad-hoc signed, not notarized.
